name: Estate Jewelry Intake Assistant
description: This is NOT an appraisal. Concept / early access, not a live service. Would let a customer upload photos of estate jewelry so an AI can draft a pre-appraisal intake sheet (item type as it appears, metal stamps that can be read, stone count and type as guesses, condition notes, and questions for the customer) for a credentialed jeweler to review. This card is static. The url does not accept A2A JSON-RPC, and no draft is issued.

skills.name: Intake draft
skills.description: Hypothetical skill. Would turn photos of a piece of estate jewelry into a draft intake sheet for a credentialed jeweler to review. The draft is not an appraisal, a value, or a gem identification. Not executable on this host.
examples: Draft an intake sheet from an illustrative description of a yellow-metal ring. This example is not a real piece and not an appraisal.
